What to do if you smell gas

If you smell gas, leave the house right away. Take everyone with you, including pets.

Do not turn lights or appliances on or off, do not use a phone or open a garage door inside the house, and do not try to find the leak.

Once you are outside and away from the building, call 911 or your gas utility's emergency line.

Do not go back inside until the gas utility or the fire department says it is safe. Only a qualified technician should repair gas pipes or appliances.
